audience: support and sales teams that chat with website visitors and customers in Smartsupp

useCases.title: Find chats that wait for an agent
useCases.text: Search the chat conversations with filters and sorting. List the agents with their status before you pick who takes the next chat.

useCases.title: Review a customer chat and its history
useCases.text: Open one conversation with its tags, rating and contact. Read its messages, then the contact record of the customer who wrote it.

useCases.title: Measure first response time and chat volume
useCases.text: Get one chat metric for a date range, such as first response time or ratings. Read the office hours settings of the account.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer and assign the chat
useCases.text: Send a reply that the customer sees, and assign the conversation to one agent. Confirm the reply text first.

useCases.title: Tag a chat and add an internal note
useCases.text: Attach an existing tag to a conversation and add an internal note for the agents. The customer does not see the note.
